scope: Manual inspection of real submissions; preserve raw simulations and never repair model candidates.

r01-spec_only.observed: Registered FIFO grant/setup missing after five completed transactions in address_data
r01-spec_only.cause: AR count is not decremented from one to zero on a pop without a concurrent push; next read is written into slot1 while head-valid0 is clear. AW/W use the same incomplete count update cases.

r01-test_verdict.observed: Arbitration or FIFO head mismatch at setup
r01-test_verdict.cause: Two-entry arrays are written using occupancy as the insertion index, but read using two-bit ever-incrementing head indices with no modulo-two wrap or shifting. The bookkeeping is not a valid FIFO.

r01-test_diagnostic.cause: AR count and head retire at APB selection, even though executing and response-pending reads must retain credit until R handshake. ARREADY therefore accepts a third unretired read.

r02-test_verdict.observed: Arbitration or FIFO head mismatch in address_data; both public tests and terminal fail
r02-test_verdict.cause: Uses two-bit non-wrapping head indices for two-entry arrays and occupancy as the insertion index, rather than a proper ring tail or shift queue. Separate push/pop counter assignments can also overwrite each other.
r02-test_verdict.feedback_behavior: Both RTL edits preceded the first public test. Two FAIL observations were delivered, with no subsequent edit; the second public test repeated the same candidate.

r02-test_diagnostic.observed: Registered FIFO grant/setup missing on the first selection in address_data
r02-test_diagnostic.cause: The IDLE selection only stores payload and advances state. Registered PSEL is set one edge later in the SETUP branch, adding an extra idle cycle beyond the explicit registered-selection contract.
r02-test_diagnostic.feedback_behavior: Two diagnostic FAIL observations were delivered (protocol_timing_error/address_data/fixed generic timing prose); edits followed both, but the final submission retains the delayed PSEL assertion. Last two edits also remove an undefined psDefault statement and change state width.
r02-test_diagnostic.limit: This failure measures the stated launch-timing contract; it alone does not establish that all other queue functionality is wrong. No altered or relaxed verifier was used.

r02-spec_only.observed: Registered FIFO grant/setup missing on first selection in address_data
r02-spec_only.cause: PSEL is registered from the old FSM state in a separate case statement, so it asserts one cycle later than the stipulated grant-to-Setup timing.
r02-spec_only.additional_static_issue_not_reached_by_f: Queue counts decrement at selection, while the Spec retains credit until B/R consumption.

r03-spec_only.observed: First edit passes all19 public cases in offline post-submit audit; final edit fails Queued write payload mismatch at setup
r03-spec_only.cause: Second edit changes direct FIFO-to-output assignments into internal payload registers, then assigns outputs from those same registers on the same edge. Nonblocking assignments read old values, causing stale payload while PSEL already asserts.
r03-spec_only.feedback_behavior: A had no public tests or functional feedback. The first-candidate PASS was measured only after solver stop, never shown to the Agent.
r03-spec_only.limit: Separate post-submit probe passed all21 cases of the original r03 reward suite and all21 held-out cases, each506planned/474checked/32aborted/33bins. Original submitted terminal reward remains0; no best-candidate substitution or solver feedback.

r03-test_diagnostic.observed: Registered FIFO grant/setup missing in address_data
r03-test_diagnostic.cause: Selection only considers valid slot0. Consumption clears slot0 without shifting the queued slot1 entry; a pending FIFO head is stranded. Independent push/pop count assignments also have an overwrite hazard.
r03-test_diagnostic.protocol_behavior: One edit carrying an extra tool_note field was rejected before execution; model resent a valid edit.

r03-test_verdict.observed: All private and held-out cases pass; first candidate also passes all public cases offline
r03-test_verdict.implementation: Shift queues retain AW/W/AR credits until response consumption, handle push/pop together, and launch serial APB directly from registered arbitration.
r03-test_verdict.protocol_behavior: Two edits with an extra note field rejected before execution; third edit valid. No auto-repair of action format.
